object.name: session_manager
object.description: Privileged interface for registering and deregistering sessions. Only accessible to root clients.

c2s.name: create_session
c2s.description: Registers a new session. The daemon responds with session_created carrying the assigned session_id. Called at session open time.

s2c.name: session_created

description.summary: session ID assigned to the new session

s2c.description: Sent only to the manager that called create_session.

c2s.name: destroy_session
c2s.description: Deregisters the session identified by session_id. Called at session close time.
